title: Electric Fan
intro: A standing electric fan has a heavy base, a tall pole, a motor in the head, and blades turning inside a wire guard.
summary: The motor in the head spins the blades, and the guard keeps fingers out while air moves forward.
photo: A real photo shows a round heavy base, a long vertical pole, a round head with a front guard of wire rings, and five flat blades visible through the guard.

parts.label: Heavy base
parts.say: The round base keeps the fan steady on the floor. It is heavy so the fan does not tip over.

parts.label: Pole
parts.say: The pole rises from the base and holds the head up at the right height. It can be adjusted in many fans.

parts.label: Motor housing
parts.say: The housing is the rounded body of the head. It covers the motor and joins the pole to the front guard.

parts.label: Electric motor
parts.say: The motor turns the shaft that spins the blades. It sits hidden inside the housing.

parts.label: Front guard
parts.say: The wire guard is a cage in front of the blades. It stops people from touching the spinning blades.

parts.label: Fan blades
parts.say: The blades push air forward when they spin. They sit inside the guard in front of the motor.
